etymologies.etymologyHTML: From kid +‎ nap (“to nab; to grab”).

definitions.definition: (transitive) To seize or detain a person unlawfully and move or conceal them; sometimes for ransom. [from 17th c.]

quote.citation: 2002 September 6, Michelle and Robert Lamoreaux, “Model Citizens”, in Totally Spies!‎[1], season 1, episode 9, spoken by Alexandra “Alex” (Jess Harnell as Jerry and Katie Leigh), Marathon Media, via Teletoon:
quote.text: Hello, ladies. How’s the Big Apple?Rotten, Jerry. Clover’s been kidnapped.Oh dear. That’s the second time this month.

definitions.definition: The crime, or an instance, of kidnapping.
